root_cause_label: Wrong-Environment Pip Usage Prevents Grounded Computation, Leading to Speculative Model Guess
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent discovered the correct MTEB programmatic path and even got mteb importing in Python 3.10, but repeatedly used the wrong-environment pip (targeting Python 3.10 instead of the active Python 3.12 venv), failed to stabilize on one working interpreter, and ultimately abandoned computation in favor of two successive unverified model guesses.
t_err_evidence: Step 14: agent runs `pip install mteb` which silently installs/confirms into Python 3.10 site-packages ('/usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages') while the active IPython interpreter is Python 3.12 (/opt/openhands-venv). This wrong-environment pip call is the decisive mistake: it does not fix the ModuleNotFoundError in the active environment, and the agent does not recognize the mismatch, setting up the chain of failures that follow.
t_commit_evidence: Step 29: agent creates /app/result.txt with the unverified guess 'intfloat/multilingual-e5-large'. At this point the output file is locked into an incorrect answer. Although the agent later overwrites it with another guess (BAAI/bge-m3 at step 33), it never returns to the grounded computation path; all remaining steps are speculation or cosmetic revision.
t_surface_evidence: Step 20: IPython cell fails with 'ModuleNotFoundError: No module named pyarrow.lib' after the agent appended Python 3.10 site-packages to the Python 3.12 runtime's sys.path. This is the first visible signal that the cross-environment hack has collapsed and the grounded execution path is broken.
trigger_explanation: There is a genuine environment obstacle (mteb installed in Python 3.10 but the active interpreter is Python 3.12 in the OpenHands venv). The agent correctly diagnosed the mismatch but then handled it incorrectly: it ran bare `pip install mteb` (which targets the Python 3.10 system pip) rather than `python3 -m pip install mteb` or `/opt/openhands-venv/bin/pip install mteb` to install into the active venv. It also attempted an unsafe sys.path cross-version injection instead of running the computation entirely under python3.10 (where mteb was confirmed working after Pillow install).
forewarning_evidence: Step 9: first IPython cell fails with 'ModuleNotFoundError: No module named mteb' revealing the interpreter mismatch early. Steps 10-16 are diagnostic repeats all confirming the same environment separation problem before the agent's flawed pip call at step 14.
